title: Defining Models with SQLAlchemy
description: Create database models (tables) using SQLAlchemy's declarative base.

slides.title: What is a Model? 🗃️
slides.content:
# Models = Database Tables

A model is a Python class that represents a database table. Each attribute maps to a column.

We define models by inheriting from `Base` (the declarative base).

```python
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String, nullable=False)
    email = Column(String, unique=True, index=True)
```

slides.title: Example: User Model
slides.content: Let's create a simple User model.
slides.codeSnippet:
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Boolean
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String, unique=True, index=True, nullable=False)
    username = Column(String, unique=True, index=True, nullable=False)
    hashed_password = Column(String, nullable=False)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)

quizData.question: What does `__tablename__` specify in a SQLAlchemy model?

options.text: The name of the table in the database
The name of the Python class

quizData.explanation: `__tablename__` is used to specify the database table name for the model.

slides.title: Column Types
slides.content:
# Common Column Types

- `Integer` – whole numbers
- `String` – text (with optional length)
- `Boolean` – True/False
- `DateTime` – date and time
- `Float` – decimal numbers
- `ForeignKey` – for relationships

**Constraints:**
- `primary_key=True`
- `nullable=False` (NOT NULL)
- `unique=True`
- `index=True` – speeds up queries
- `default` – default value

slides.title: Extended Model Example
slides.content: A more complete model with multiple columns.
slides.codeSnippet:
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, DateTime, Boolean, Float
from datetime import datetime

class Product(Base):
    __tablename__ = "products"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    description = Column(String(500))
    price = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    in_stock = Column(Boolean, default=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content: Always add `index=True` to columns you will frequently filter or sort by. It dramatically improves query performance.

quizData.question: Which constraint ensures a column cannot have duplicate values?
quizData.explanation: `unique=True` enforces that all values in the column are distinct.
